review_conclusions: PresentationInputs rebuilds each original source_review against actual SQL/resources, reconstructs strict v1/v2/v3 coordination, compares original copied materials, complete IR/report/Markdown bytes and inventory; no status-only acceptance found.

Using the first original spelling for a normalized fact was examined, but no information-loss bug was substantiated: grouping removes whitespace/sorts condition sets, complete provenance retains all original atoms, and detail paragraphs include every distinct original atom content. Existing canonical-fact semantics were not changed.

Controlled Markdown is independently parsed after writing; content and link ranges are separated, fact cells are checked against object/property pairs, missing cells cannot carry facts, and every retained fact must be represented.
Presentation cleanup attempts both reports first and continues after a changed captured artifact; only captured unchanged non-hidden outputs are removed. Unknown bytes and hidden originals survive.

Windows held-file test design covers v1/v2/v3 cases/bundles/coordination, SQL/raw/normalized inputs and all captured outputs using actual fs::write/fs::remove_file attempts at inputs_held and results_saved. This is test coverage review, not Windows execution evidence.
